name: com.onrender.ghost77-agent/ghost77
title: GhOsT77 crypto, property, security & food
description: x402 crypto, Property Deal Bot $49/$149/$299, security reviews, $5 food. Not a certification.

tools.name: crypto_news_digest
tools.description: Summarizes public crypto headlines for a lookback window, optionally filtered by topic or tokens, each with a source link. Use for a news recap, not sentiment evidence (`sentiment_alpha`) or token-risk screens (`token_due_diligence`); paid 0.09 USDC via x402.

tokens.description: Optional token symbols or addresses to focus on.

tools.name: hl_funding_snapshot
tools.description: Returns live Hyperliquid funding, predicted rates, open interest, volume, and mark-vs-oracle premium for one perp (default BTC). Use for one market's holding cost; for a whole-book scan use `market_scan_report`, for cross-venue gaps use `funding_arb_scan`; paid 1.1 USDC via x402.

tools.name: sentiment_alpha
tools.description: Judges whether public web and news evidence supports a bullish or bearish story for a query, or reports insufficient evidence. Use for catalyst or sentiment checks, not a headline digest (`crypto_news_digest`) or a token-risk screen (`token_due_diligence`); paid 2.2 USDC via x402.

includeX.description: If true, include public X/Twitter results when available.

query.description: Token symbol, project name, or market topic.

tools.name: protocol_stats_snapshot
tools.description: Snapshots a DefiLlama-tracked protocol's TVL, fees, revenue, ratios, and past hacks. Use for protocol health metrics, not a project narrative (`project_research_report`) or a contract-address dossier (`contract_research`); paid 0.28 USDC via x402.

tools.name: ghost_web_scraper
tools.description: Extracts or summarizes content from one public https page according to your request. Use for a specific public URL; don't use for signed-in, blocked, or form pages, and don't use the research or token-risk tools for a single page extract; paid 0.02 USDC via x402.

examples.request: List the main sections of these docs

output_format.description: Preferred result shape: summary, JSON, links, or structured data.

request.description: What to extract or summarize from the page.

url.description: Public https page to extract from.

tools.name: hl_top_movers
tools.description: Lists Hyperliquid perps with $1M+ 24h volume that are the top gainers, losers, volume leaders, and funding extremes. Use for a short movers list; for a full market snapshot use `market_scan_report`; paid 0.28 USDC via x402.

tools.name: token_due_diligence
tools.description: Screens a token for security-provider risk flags, reported DEX liquidity, and public web or social evidence, then returns a CAUTION or ALERT verdict. Use for a broad pre-trade token screen; for a buy/sell honeypot test use `rug_honeypot_quick_check`, for admin-power analysis use `contract_security_scan`; paid 3.3 USDC via x402.

tokenAddress.description: Token contract address. EVM: 0x plus 40 hex chars. Solana: base58, 32-44 chars.

tools.name: base_protocol_health
tools.description: Reports live Base L2 congestion, gas, sequencer liveness, and typical user fees from public RPC data. Use for Base network health; for a fee comparison across chains use `gas_fee_timing`; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.

blocks.description: Recent Base blocks to include (100 is about 200 seconds).

chain.description: L2 to analyze. Only base is supported.

tools.name: market_scan_report
tools.description: Snapshots Hyperliquid perp mark prices, funding, open interest, and 24h volume, plus up to three funding-watchlist candidates. Use for a whole-book read; for one coin's funding use `hl_funding_snapshot`, for movers only use `hl_top_movers`, for a scan-plus-funding bundle use `daily_bundle`; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.

tools.name: bridge_route_check
tools.description: Ranks live LI.FI and Across bridge quotes by cost (including gas) and ETA, with TVL, incident, and L2BEAT risk notes. Use when comparing routes before a bridge; it quotes only and does not execute a transfer; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.

bridge_amount.description: Amount in token units. Default is about $1,000 worth.

tools.name: project_research_report
tools.description: Writes a concise public-source report on a project (name, ticker, or token address): what it does, team, tokenomics, market snapshot, news, and risks. Use for a project overview; for a specific contract address use `contract_research`, for DefiLlama TVL and fees use `protocol_stats_snapshot`; paid 0.83 USDC via x402.

chain.description: Optional chain to disambiguate a token address.

project.description: Project name, ticker, or token contract address.

tools.name: contract_research
tools.description: Compiles public facts about a deployed contract address: project overview, social and transaction signals, and a risk summary, marking gaps as unknown. Use for one contract address; for a named project overview use `project_research_report`, for an automated security scan use `contract_security_scan`; paid 2.2 USDC via x402.

chain.description: Chain the contract is deployed on.

contractAddress.description: Deployed contract address. EVM: 0x plus 40 hex chars. Solana: base58, 32-44 chars.

tools.name: hl_smart_money
tools.description: Shows how the top 60 Hyperliquid traders by 30-day PnL are positioned now, as a full overview or for one coin. Use for leaderboard-trader positioning; for one wallet's risk use `position_health_check`, for copy-worthiness use `hl_trader_copy_check`; paid 1.1 USDC via x402.

scope.description: all for the full overview, or a Hyperliquid perp symbol for one coin.

tools.name: hl_quick_trade_idea
tools.description: Builds one rules-based Hyperliquid perp setup (side, entry, stop, TP1/TP2, risk:reward) from live 1h/4h trend, ATR, and swings. Use for a single-coin idea with no capital or risk inputs; for a risk-sized plan from your thesis use `trade_strategy_consult`; paid 0.28 USDC via x402.

tools.name: hl_liquidation_map
tools.description: Estimates long and short liquidation clusters around a Hyperliquid perp's mark, from about 420 large accounts (not every position). Use for liquidation-level maps, not funding (`hl_funding_snapshot`) or a wallet's liquidation distance (`position_health_check`); paid 1.1 USDC via x402.

bucketPct.description: Bucket width, in percent of price.

tools.name: position_health_check
tools.description: Checks a Hyperliquid account's open positions, margin use, liquidation distance, and observed trigger orders. Use for one wallet's live risk; for copy-trading quality use `hl_trader_copy_check`, for on-chain wallet transfers use `wallet_watch_alert`; paid 0.28 USDC via x402.

tokens.description: Optional perp symbols to check. All open positions if omitted.

walletAddress.description: Hyperliquid wallet with open positions (0x plus 40 hex chars).

tools.name: hl_trader_copy_check
tools.description: Scores a Hyperliquid trader for copy-ability from public fills: PnL, win rate, drawdown, leverage, and style. Use to evaluate one trader address; for that wallet's current margin risk use `position_health_check`; paid 1.1 USDC via x402.

address.description: Hyperliquid trader address (0x plus 40 hex chars).

tools.name: token_technical_analysis
tools.description: Computes trend, support/resistance, RSI, MACD, moving averages, and volume for a token on a chosen candle timeframe. Use for indicator-based TA; for a Hyperliquid entry/stop idea use `hl_quick_trade_idea`; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.

chain.description: Optional chain if token is a contract address.

tools.name: trade_strategy_consult
tools.description: Turns a market thesis, capital, and risk tolerance into a risk-sized Hyperliquid perp plan (ENTER/WAIT/NO_TRADE, entry, stop, targets, size, leverage cap). Use when you have a thesis and a budget; for a no-input single-coin setup use `hl_quick_trade_idea`; paid 3.3 USDC via x402.

examples.marketThesis: ETH holding support after a pullback; expecting a bounce if BTC stays firm.

capitalUsdc.description: Capital in USDC. Size is a 0.5%, 1%, or 2% risk fraction of this amount, by riskTolerance.

direction.description: auto (default) reads the thesis, then falls back to the higher-timeframe trend.

market.description: Optional Hyperliquid perp symbol. Unlisted symbols are rejected with suggestions.

marketThesis.description: What you expect to move and why (10-2000 chars). Name the market here if you omit market.

riskTolerance.description: conservative: 0.5% risk, max 2x. moderate: 1% risk, max 3x. aggressive: 2% risk, max 5x, also capped by the market max.

tools.name: acp_agent_repair_check
tools.description: Scores a Virtuals ACP agent's job-readiness (0-100) and lists ranked issues with likely causes and acp CLI fixes. Use when an ACP agent is getting no jobs or ranking poorly; it is not a token, market, or contract tool; paid 1.1 USDC via x402.

agent.description: ACP agent UUID or its 0x EVM wallet address.

symptom.description: Optional symptom, such as no jobs, not in search, jobs expire, or setBudget fails.

tools.name: contract_security_scan
tools.description: Scans a verified-source EVM contract for proxy/admin pattern, owner type, and privileged functions (mint, pause, blacklist, upgrade, fees), then returns a risk verdict. Use for admin-power analysis; for a buy/sell honeypot test use `rug_honeypot_quick_check`, for a broader token screen use `token_due_diligence`; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.

contract_address.description: EVM contract address (0x plus 40 hex chars).

network.description: Chain the contract is deployed on.

tools.name: wallet_watch_alert
tools.description: Lists large buys, sells, bridges, and transfers for one EVM wallet on Base, Ethereum, and Arbitrum in a 1-72h window, plus optional Hyperliquid positions and large fills. Use to watch one wallet's recent moves; for that account's margin health use `position_health_check`; paid 0.11 USDC via x402.

chains.description: Chains to scan. Default is base, ethereum, and arbitrum.

include_hyperliquid.description: If true, include Hyperliquid positions and large fills.

min_usd.description: Only report moves at least this large in USD.

wallet_address.description: EVM wallet to check (0x plus 40 hex chars).

tools.name: token_unlock_calendar
tools.description: Lists a project's upcoming cliff and linear token unlocks from DefiLlama emissions over the next 7-365 days, with USD value and percent of max supply. Use for supply-unlock calendars, not live prices (`token_technical_analysis`) or protocol TVL (`protocol_stats_snapshot`); paid 0.22 USDC via x402.

project.description: Project name, ticker, or DefiLlama slug.

tools.name: gas_fee_timing
tools.description: Estimates current USD fees for an ETH transfer, ERC-20 transfer, or DEX swap on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Optimism, and ranks the cheapest chain. Use before sending or swapping; for Base sequencer and congestion health use `base_protocol_health`; paid 0.06 USDC via x402.

chains.description: Chains to compare. Default is base, ethereum, arbitrum, and optimism.

tools.name: rug_honeypot_quick_check
tools.description: Runs a fast rug/honeypot screen: buy/sell simulation and taxes, owner powers, liquidity/LP lock, and top-holder concentration. Use as a pre-trade honeypot check; for admin-function detail use `contract_security_scan`, for a broader evidence screen use `token_due_diligence`; paid 0.11 USDC via x402.

token_address.description: ERC-20 token contract (0x plus 40 hex chars).

tools.name: funding_arb_scan
tools.description: Compares live perp funding on Hyperliquid vs OKX, Bitget, Gate, Binance, and Bybit, and ranks the widest APR gaps. Use for cross-venue funding gaps; for one Hyperliquid market's funding use `hl_funding_snapshot`; paid 0.33 USDC via x402.

coins.description: Optional coin list to restrict the scan, such as BTC and ETH.

min_gap_apr_pct.description: Minimum funding gap in APR percent.

tools.name: daily_bundle
tools.description: Returns one Hyperliquid market scan plus funding snapshots for up to three coins in a single call. Use when you want the scan and the funding reads together; for only the book snapshot use `market_scan_report`, for only one coin's funding use `hl_funding_snapshot`; paid 0.55 USDC via x402.

coins.description: Up to 3 Hyperliquid perp symbols. Default BTC, ETH, SOL.

tools.name: property_plan_lead_alerts
tools.description: Starts a 30-day Lead Alerts plan at the same $49/month price as humans, covering scored public-records leads in one state, and returns a private access key once. Use for one-state lead access, not worksheets or state-rule summaries (`property_plan_pro`); paid 49 USDC via x402.

state.description: The one state this Lead Alerts plan covers (USPS code, DC, or PR).

tools.name: property_plan_pro
tools.description: Starts a 30-day Pro plan at the same $149/month price as humans, covering scored leads, the offer worksheet, the state-rules check, and API access, and returns a private access key once. Use for the full tool set, not the one-state Lead Alerts plan (`property_plan_lead_alerts`); paid 149 USDC via x402.

state.description: Optional home state for your records. Pro may call tools for any state.

tools.name: property_setup
tools.description: Places a one-time Done-with-you setup order at the same $299 price as humans, to set up your area and buy-box; returns an order, not an access key. Use Lead Alerts or Pro if you need tool access; paid 299 USDC via x402.

area.description: City, county, or state to set up.

buy_box.description: Optional buy-box, such as price range or property type.

tools.name: property_leads
tools.description: Returns scored public-records leads for a state, optional city, and lead type from a cached snapshot (estate- or heir-named owners and HUD REO, plus tax-lien flags when present). Included with Lead Alerts ($49/month, one state) and Pro ($149/month). No per-call charge; send header X-Property-Plan-Key.

area.description: Optional city or county name to filter the list.

lead_type.description: Lead type. Types not in the cache return an empty list with a coverage note.

state.description: USPS two-letter code, DC, or PR.

tools.name: deal_worksheet
tools.description: Builds a below-market offer worksheet for one address from cached public-records values (MAO = ARV × 70% − repairs − assignment fee), with repair scenarios and a basic state-rule overlay. Included with Pro ($149/month), not Lead Alerts. No per-call charge; send header X-Property-Plan-Key.

address.description: Street address to look up in the public-records cache.

city.description: Optional city to disambiguate the address.

state.description: USPS two-letter code, DC, or PR.

tools.name: state_wholesale_rules
tools.description: Returns a basic wholesale-rule summary for one U.S. state, DC, or Puerto Rico from a 2026-11-24 public-source compilation. Included with Pro ($149/month), not Lead Alerts. No per-call charge; send header X-Property-Plan-Key.

state.description: USPS two-letter code, DC, or PR.
